featured_reviews.name: Pawan Dawra
featured_reviews.review_text: Last month, I was the victim of online fraud involving your agent, Sachin Singh, who claimed to represent HDFC Bank. He offered me a loan of Rs 10 lakhs against my car and an additional Rs 7 lakhs to help me start my business. I explained my health condition and my urgent need for funds. After several phone conversations, he assured me there would be no issues with the loan process. Initially, I was paying Rs 16K for a 10 lakh HDFC car loan, but I am now paying Rs 29,000 for the same amount. After the Rs 10 lakh loan was approved, he said he would process the Rs 7 lakh loan for my business. During the process, I discovered he was actually from Bada Finance, not HDFC, which was very concerning as I was already deeply involved in the loan process. He instructed me to share an OTP and click on a link to submit my application, assuring me it was necessary. Trusting him, I followed his instructions. After the loan was processed, Rs 7 lakhs was paid to HDFC, and I was supposed to receive the remaining Rs 2.98 lakhs. However, I only received Rs 1.39 lakhs, with the rest paid in small amounts. I did not receive Rs 46,000 because I was unknowingly enrolled in a Hero Cop scheme. Upon review, I realized that by clicking all the options in the link, as instructed by Sachin Singh, I had unknowingly accepted this scheme. He pressured me to act quickly, saying there was no time to read the details. As a result, I am now paying Rs 29,000 per month without justification, while also managing expensive medical treatment. This experience has been distressing, and I do not want anyone else to go through the same situation. I will continue to raise awareness and share my experience with others. This is unacceptable, especially after I explained my medical condition.

featured_reviews.name: Imran Sayed
featured_reviews.review_text: "Embarking on any financial journey for the first time can be daunting, but thanks to the exceptional guidance and unwavering support from Deepali, my experience has been nothing short of remarkable. Over the past 5+ years, she has consistently demonstrated a profound understanding of my financial aspirations and has meticulously tailored her strategies to suit my needs. Her commitment to educating me throughout the investment process has not only instilled confidence but also empowered me to make informed decisions. I now find myself discussing mutual funds and equities with ease, thanks to her insightful explanations during our detailed calls. One instance that truly exemplifies her dedication to my financial well-being is when I was relocating to another country. She proactively navigated the complex taxation landscape and recommended liquidating my mutual funds to streamline my finances. This selfless act underscores her prioritization of my best interests above all else. Without hesitation, she executed the necessary steps to ensure a smooth transition, showcasing her unwavering commitment to my financial success. I am immensely grateful for Deepali's expertise, professionalism, and genuine care, and I wholeheartedly recommend her services to anyone seeking a trustworthy and dedicated financial advisor."
